Question 18
?

Use a fundamental vector product to determine which of the following integrals gives the surface area generated when the curve y=1z2 is rotated by 2π radians about the z-axis for z∈[1,5].

a
2π∫151z21+4z6dz
b
2π∫151z41+4z6dz
c
2π∫151z41−1z3dz
d
2π∫151z21+2z3dz
e
2π∫151z41+2z3dz
Submit
